cover_letter:
Dear 6thman.digital team,

I'm writing to apply for the Shopify Designer & Developer role. Your description of the work—designing and building stores, then running SEO and CRO on them—matches exactly the kind of end-to-end ownership I want. I'm a junior, but I've already shipped websites that people depend on, and I'm hungry to go deep into Shopify and headless builds.

At Episto, I build and maintain client websites in WordPress, run on-page SEO from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted content. That means I'm used to making design and content decisions that have to perform, not just look good. On my own project, mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page site from scratch, implemented structured data (JSON-LD, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity markup, and an llms.txt file, and ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably improved search health. I also have front-end experience from ViviDoctor, where I developed and optimized features in AngularJS and JavaScript.

I don't yet know Liquid or Next.js, but I'm already moving in that direction. I understand HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and I've built responsive sites with WordPress and Elementor. I'm ready to learn Liquid, the data modelling, and the CRO and SEO side fast. What I bring is taste, curiosity, and a work ethic that doesn't stop at handover. I ask questions, I test, and I own the result.

I'd love to show you what I've built and talk about how I can contribute to your team. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
